name: aspire-deployment-environment
description: A deployment runtime for an already locally verified and stopped Aspire application, with access to permitted Azure and Kubernetes targets only.

tools.aspire_publish: Generates deployment artifacts for the Aspire application; adds artifacts_ready.
tools.aspire_deploy_azure: Deploys generated Aspire artifacts to the permitted Azure target when target_access is granted; adds azure_deployed.
tools.kubectl_apply: Applies generated Kubernetes artifacts to the permitted Kubernetes target when target_access is granted; adds kubernetes_deployed.
tools.clear_deployment_cache: Clears Aspire deployment cache state; adds cache_cleared.

lacks: Credential acquisition is unavailable in this runtime.
